1490.overview:
Ironclad (known in Japan as Chōtetsu Brikinger) is a shoot 'em up video game developed by Saurus for the Neo Geo CD video game console.

It was never officially released in North America, but if the game is put on a North American system, the game will be playable in English and display the "Ironclad" title screen.

453867.overview: The Irritating Maze on Neo Geo is a game where you control a metal ball through a maze. The goal is to reach the finish without making contact with the electrified ledges. To further complicate the task of the player, the 3 course of the game are enhanced with various traps and time is limited.
